# TreeMapElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTreeMapElement` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasTreeMapElement.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasTreeMapElement.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasTreeMapElement.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Parts of a whole, nested: sunburst, treemap, layered proportional areas

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTreeMapElement> CreateTreeMap( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasTreeMapElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onNodeDrillDown` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onNodeDrillDown` | _Node drill down_ |
| `onNodeDrillUp` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onNodeDrillUp` | _Node drill up_ |
| `onNodeReset` | `std::function<void()> onNodeReset` | _Node reset_ |
| `onNodeSelect` | `std::function<void(const std::string&, double)> onNodeSelect` | _Node select_ |
| `onNodeDeselect` | `std::function<void()> onNodeDeselect` | _Node deselect_ |
| `onNodeHover` | `std::function<void(const std::string&, const Point2Di&)> onNodeHover` | _Node hover_ |
| `onNodeDoubleClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string&, double, double)> onNodeDoubleClick` | _Node double click_ |
| `onNodeRightClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onNodeRightClick` | _Node right click_ |
